# rok-data

> One schema. All changes. PostgreSQL data tooling for Rust,
> consolidated from the rok ecosystem (rok-db, rok-fluent, rok-orm,
> rok-sqlc): one runtime behind the `rok-data` facade, two generators,
> and one CLI — `rok` (published as `rok-data-cli`). The project's schema
> directory is the only source of truth; `rok init` and `rok gen` turn it
> into a typed Rust data layer and an actix-web or axum API.
> Rust ≥ 1.94, PostgreSQL 12+.

## This site

- `/` — the home: what rok-data is, the workspace's crates, the loop.
- `/guide/installation` — `cargo install rok-data-cli`, `cargo add
  rok-data`, platform notes.
- `/guide/getting-started` — the front door (`rok init`, `rok gen`,
  staged pairs, `rok gen check`), the runtime by hand, derives.
- `/agents` — the machine contracts: `--json` shapes, exit codes, the
  unattended schema-change loop, the in-repo agent skills.
- `/crates/rok-data` — the facade applications depend on.
- `/crates/rok-data-core` — `Db`, `Expr`/`Select`, migrations,
  introspection, paging.
- `/crates/rok-data-macros` — `#[derive(Model)]`, the other derives,
  `#[rok_data::test]`.
- `/crates/rok-data-codegen` — the whole-crate generator and the
  migration diff engine (legacy `rok generate`).
- `/crates/rok-data-sqlc` — the resource-module engine, templates,
  check-arch, OpenAPI.
- `/crates/rok-cli` — the `rok` binary: every command, flag and exit
  code (install: `cargo install rok-data-cli`).

## The repository's AI-friendly markdown

The authoritative docs are the repo's `docs/` tree — every page
self-contained for pasting into a coding agent:

- Index for machines:
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ateeq1999/rok-data/main/docs/llms.txt
- Agent skills (OpenCode/Claude/AGENTS-spec discoverable):
  `.agents/skills/rok-data*/SKILL.md` — `rok-data`, `rok-data-init`,
  `rok-data-models`, `rok-data-migrations`, `rok-data-sqlc`.
- Source: https://github.com/ateeq1999/rok-data
